name: Seed of Dreams
subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
description:
A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. This mere atom contains boundless noise, each tiny vibration the hopes and dreams of entire lifetimes.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

name: Seed of Power
subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
description:
A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A particle of indescribable energy, it is unclear how to continues to exist within this reality.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

name: Seed of Will
subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
description:
A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A flash of pure light and fury, this seed contains the unsuppressable need to exist.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

name: Seed of Life
subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
description:
A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. Though a mere speck, this seed contains the potential for an entire universe; a boundless, glorious expansion.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

name: Seed of Hope
subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
description:
A seed of creation, a perfect droplet of infinity. A gift from the Atlas, this is a tiny fragment of all the universe's dreams, will, power and life; a fragment of the Travellers; a fragment of myself.

Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

name: Echo Seed
subtitle: Crystalline Sentience Cage
description:
The Seed is an echo of life, the last reverberations of a living being.

This sentience was fused with a lattice of Atlantideum, as though it had germinated together with the crystal.

name: Echo Collective
subtitle: Consciousness Housing
description:
A shifting vortex of atlantideum, attuned to the growing collective will housed inside Nada's Prime Terminal. Current sentience threshold: ??%.

The grains oscillate in a pattern, but the message is unintelligible.

name: Fibreglass Grip
subtitle: Voltaic Component
description:
A strap of flexible resin, securely wrapped around a steel pole.

One of three core components, this forms the backbone of a traditional Autophage Voltaic Staff.

name: Atlantideum Chamber
subtitle: Voltaic Component
description:
A compact box of circuitry and ethereal crystals, painstakingly wired by hand.

One of three core components, this forms the core of a traditional Autophage Voltaic Staff.

name: Concentric Transducer
subtitle: Voltaic Component
description:
An electrified arrangement of mechanical wheels. Transforms stored energy into beams or propulsion, according to the specifications of weapons and laser attachments.

One of three core components, this forms the head of a traditional Autophage Voltaic Staff.

subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas
description:

Reach the stars and then use FE_ALT1 to awaken this memory.

name: The Angler's Diary
subtitle: Collected Flotsam
description:
A message recovered from a bottle stowed beneath the seat of the starship. It reads:

"I finally feel like I'm getting closer. A trader on Gisto offered me solid-gold information on its location, for a price.
And so I'm selling my ship. I'll miss the Celeste, but I have to know if the rumours are true. I hope whoever buys you takes good care of you..."
%PARTY_1%

name: The Angler's Diary
subtitle: Collected Flotsam
description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

"The rumours were true. It's out there, I can feel it. Not here, but somewhere. The water calls to me, I just need to follow its voice..."
%PARTY_3%

name: The Angler's Diary
subtitle: Collected Flotsam
description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

"I saw it in my dreams last night. Scales like fire and eyes of pure starlight. It sang to me, a song of hope and longing. It wants me to find it, I know it. I must be closing in."
%PARTY_4%

name: The Angler's Diary
subtitle: Collected Flotsam
description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

"I was right! It was here! After all these light years, all the doubts, it's finally mine. Oh, and how it shines! Like fire in the water, beautiful, impossible..."
%PARTY_5%

name: The Angler's Diary
subtitle: Collected Flotsam
description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

"The fire has faded from my catch's scales, and my dreams have soured. I thrash through the night. My skin itches, damp and clammy. Salt seeps from my pores.
It longs to be free. I cannot keep it contained like this. It must be free.
I must be free..."

name: The Angler
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description:
Fire dances across the scales of this impossible marine being. Its starlit eyes stare back at you with a meaning far deeper than any fish should know. As they stare, the world around you fades away.

The sound of water fills your ears. It wants to be free. You want to be free...

name: Any Edible Bone
subtitle: Ingredient Category

Food such as this can be highly valuable.

name: Elixir of Glass
subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
description:
A slight membrane has begun to form over this viscous purple liquid. Beneath its glassy surface it swirls slowly, forming syrupy currents of its own accord.

The elixir will maintain your local boundary integrity and prevent the intrusion of the horrors beyond.

Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1 or inject it directly into the Anomaly Suppressor from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

name: Elixir of Quicksilver
subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
description:
The liquid's silvered surface forms a perfect mirror, your own face reflected back as you examine it. But the more you stare, the less perfect the mirror becomes. The face in the image moves. It blinks. It -

Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1 to reveal the location of nearby portals.

name: Elixir of BloodPR_10<>
subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
description:
Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time.

A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_10.

Present the elixir at a portal, or consume it with FE_ALT1 to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.

name: Elixir of Water
subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
description:
The water in this vessel seems to stretch on forever, plunging down to dizzying depths, far beyond what the container could possibly hold.

Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1. Beware what lurks in the deep water...

name: Elixir of BloodPR_4<>
subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
description:

To bind such a place to the rest of reality, a proper anchor is required...

A titanium flightpack, assembled from technology stolen from the Sentinel horde. Its engines are precooled with a constant flow of pugneum and nitrogen, ensuring fuel-efficient and deadly silent operation.

Warning: do not unseal pugneum containment chamber without protective gear.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

name: Shroud of Freedom
subtitle: Unlockable Hood
description:
A flowing silken shroud, bestowed upon those who would sing with Voice of Freedom.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit with this exclusive Appearance Override at an Appearance Modifier.

name: Starborn Phoenix
subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
description:
An exclusive reforged starship, commemorating a time when Travellers old and new joined together to voyage across the stars.

This unusual ship is optimised for effortless gliding during flight, while a localised vector field allows the craft to hover above solid planes.

Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

name: Horizon Vector NX
subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
description:
An exclusive Starship. This compact fighter craft boasts superior manoeuvrability, giving it an edge in space combat.

Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

name: Infinite Neon Mark XXII
subtitle: Exclusive Multifunction Survival Device
description:
An exclusive Multi-Tool. This brightly-coloured rifle offers the user cutting-edge defensive capabilities in ground combat situations.

Take this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

name: Streamlined Jetpack Unit
subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
description:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.

A streamlined and lightweight backpack unit, featuring an elegant single-thruster design. This exclusive exosuit augmentation commemorates completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

name: Golden First Spawn Battle Mask
subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
description:
An aggressive Exosuit Appearance Override, modeled on the war helmets of the ancient Gek. This special edition is cast in a durable and precious alloy.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

name: Golden Vector
subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
description:
An exclusive golden edition of the iconic Alpha Vector Starship, commemorating completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

This highly-manoeuvrable spacecraft is constructed from a durable and precious alloy, and coated in a tough layer of fibrous insulation to endure many lifetimes' worth of rigorous space exploration.

Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

name: Title: 'Pioneer'
subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

name: Pioneers Expedition Decal
subtitle: Decoration
description:
An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases.
This decal features the golden edition of the iconic Alpha Vector Starship, and commemorates completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

name: Pioneers Expedition Banner
subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.
Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

name: Atlas Firework Pack
subtitle: Pyrotechnics Multi-Pack
description:
A three-variety pack of luxury fireworks. These stunning pyrotechnics render the likeness of an Atlas Interface, in bursts of indium, gold and cadmium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Blue-Red Atlas Firework
subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
description:
A stunning pyrotechnic rendition of an Atlas Interface, rendered in a burst of indium and cadmium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Gold-Blue Atlas Firework
subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
description:

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Red-Gold Atlas Firework
subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
description:
A stunning pyrotechnic rendition of an Atlas Interface, rendered in a burst of cadmium and gold. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Flesh Launcher
subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
description:
A luxury firework. These organic pyrotechnics rocket into the sky and explode in a splatter of slime, plasma and wormlets. Ignite to create disgusting displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Flesh Launcher Pack
subtitle: Pyrotechnics Multi-Pack
description:
A pack of luxury fireworks. These organic pyrotechnics rocket into the sky and explode in a splatter of slime, mucus, and wormlets. Ignite to create disgusting displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Pioneers Expedition Flag
subtitle: Unlockable Decoration
description:
An exclusive buildable base ornament.
This elaborate, gold-fringed flag features a rendition of the iconic Alpha Vector Starship. Plant in a habitable base to commemorate completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

name: SSV Normandy SR1
subtitle: Exclusive Frigate
description:
The SSV Normandy SR1 is a one-of-a-kind 'deep scout' frigate. This legendary ship represents peace and cooperation between races, and commemorates completion of the 'Beachhead' Expedition.

Recruiting this frigate will add it to your fleet. Manage your frigate fleet from a Fleet Command Room aboard your freighter, and consult your Navigator to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.

name: Historiographical Dosimeter
subtitle: Personal Reality Flux Monitor
description:
Nada has detected a new pattern emerging in the stories of the Gek, Korvax, and Vy'keen.

The dosimeter measures exposure to historiographical flux around key artifact sites. Recordings of unusual historical shifts will enable Nada to trace the signal.

Assist Nada and Polo in their research by using this device to transmit historial data from alien artifact sites.

name: Whispering Companion Egg
subtitle: Horrific Spawn

A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A shadow writhes beneath the egg's protective membrane.

name: Sandworm Egg
subtitle: Titanic Spawn
description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be cursed and insatiable.

Ritualistically transform the head of your Vy'keen appearance at an Appearance Modifier.

The jetpack exhaust is fitted with a high-concentrate pugneum dispenser. When the jets are activated, the resulting reaction carves miniature distortions in reality, and creates an interesting visual effect.

Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

Washing requires specialist equipment.

Hundreds of years of high-tech research, as applied to footwear.

name: Robotic Companion
subtitle: Personal Drone Valet
description:
A perfectly-programmed and error free drone.

This miniature robot will be a lively presence in your base, bringing joy, laughter and a constant low-level humming to your home.

name: Expanding Cube Gadget
subtitle: Unlockable Decoration
description:
An exclusive decorative curiosity.

This precisely crafted gadget utilises a localised gravitational field, delighting and fascinating base visitors.

name: Holographic Globe Gadget
subtitle: Unlockable Decoration
description:
An exclusive decorative curiosity for bases.

This gadget emits a spherical hologram, representative of one of the quintillions of celestial bodies populating the galaxies.

name: Wriggling Companion
subtitle: Betentacled Steward
description:
The captured essence of an abyssal horror, contained for scientific and decorative use.

The bounding forcefield is of the very highest quality. The companion cannot escape. The companion will not escape. Escape.

name: Fruit Tree
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A large decorative fruit tree.

Fruit form, toxicity and existence will vary according to local climatic and pollinator conditions.

name: Spindle Tree
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A thin, non-fruiting tree. Root system is integrated with highly-adapted fungal symbiotes.

Supplied with its own mushrooms for ease of establishment. Fungus is non-toxic and non-spreading.

name: Evergreen Tree
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A hardy evergreen tree, able to survive in a wide-range of climates.

Waxy leaves with a silvery underside provide excellent light harvesting abilities, as well as year-round interest and colour.

name: Carnivorous Bush
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A medium-sized decorative plant. Each of its leaves is covered in a thin film of sticky latex. Insects that land on these leaves are slowly absorbed by digestive hormones mixed in with the glue.

Avoid accidental skin contact.

name: Dwarf Palm
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A squat, easily-managed form of the larger palm species.

Place outdoors to attract wildlife and to purify the air.

name: Curious Corn
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
Sprouting decorative corn. Comes in a variety of colours. May attract decorative wildlife.

Unable to reproduce naturally. Must be hand-pollinated.

name: Small Aquarium
subtitle: Aquatic Observation Module
description:
A small observatory unit for studying aquatic behaviours.

Completely self-contained, with its own renewable energy source, pump array, and self-cleaning filtration systems.

name: Curly Coral
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A delicate marine invertebrate, cultivated for potted growth. Its distinctive looping structure gives it an attractive whimsical appearance.

name: Aquatic Crystal
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: An eye-catching cluster of crystallised oceanic minerals. These crystals grow in a shard-like structure, and feature an unusual marbled colouration.

name: Candelabra Bloom
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A striking plant featuring luminescent, orb-shaped flowers. This domestic variety has adapted to absorb and process oxygen from any source, whether growing on land or underwater.

name: Armoured Anemone
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A carnivorous marine organism. An armoured shell encloses the core polyp, exposing only the stinging tentacles. Involuntary nerve spasms cause the creature to writhe perpetually: always seeking, always hungering.

name: Strip Coral
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A giant calcium formation, naturally configured into a strip of non-orientable space. Adds a mysterious deep-sea quality to any habitable base.

name: Aquatic Colony
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A rock formation pulled from the floor of a densely-populated ocean. The attached marine life is lacquered in a nutrient-rich mucus, to keep it fed and moist in terrestrial conditions.

name: Barnacle
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A tenacious arthropod, naturally found encrusting stationary or slow-moving underwater objects.

This variety can be encouraged to affix itself to a chosen position, adding an aged marine appearance to bases.

name: Blue Firework
subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
description:
A luxury firework, rich in magnesium and indium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Red Firework
subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
description:

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Wheel of Hirk Firework
subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
description:

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Red Titan Firework
subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
description:

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Purple Ribbon Firework

description:

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

name: Pocket Reality Generator
subtitle: Unlockable Decoration
description:
An exclusive decorative curiosity for bases.

A model of reality itself, as viewed from the perspective of an impossible observer. Infinite levels of detail wait to be discovered by the viewer with a powerful enough lens.

name: Terrarium
subtitle: Specialised Creature Enclosure
description:
A small observatory unit for studying animal behaviours.

Completely self-contained, complete with inbuilt nutrient processor, air purifier and faecal disposal system.

name: Sail Palm
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A large-leafed, heat resistant tree.

Its broad fronds are laced with minerals, forming a protective barrier against the harsh sunlight of its native conditions.

name: Globe Tree
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A thin tree with a large, fleshy root system, well adapted to hot climates.

Root bulb may be tapped for a source of drinkable liquid, but this is not advised outside of the most dire circumstances.

name: Rock Garden
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A garden module, complete with decorative mineral formation and built-in capillary matting for optimum humidity control.

name: Writhing Bush
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A native of radioactive worlds, this curiously meaty succulent seems to sway gently even when the air is still...

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Umbrella Tree
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This decorative tree has evolved to cope with high levels of background radiation. Its central glowing core attracts wildlife and is in no way a sense organ. It does not watch you.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Entwining Tree
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This beautiful statement tree thrives in the heat of intense gamma radiation. To ensure survival in non-native environments, a chunk of high-energy material has been embedded in the trunk.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Blistering Mushroom
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This swollen protuberance grows rapidly from a fine network of underground spores. Greatly improves nearby soil quality.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Watchful Protrusion
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
While this plant can be cultivated as a crop, consumption is not advised.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Tentacle Spire
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This delightful architectural floral combines two highly popular aesthetics: wriggling tentacles and giant fungi.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Bewitching Cactus
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
Elegant feathery filaments run around this desert plant, increasing the surface area for moisture absorption. They also look very fetching.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Celebratory Cactus
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
Delightful succulent baubles, these lovely plants top their bulbous bodies with a show of beautiful flowers.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Succulent Tree
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
The bark on this tree is misleading. Neither rough nor hard, its flesh is instead soft and moist to the touch. Wrinkles in the surface store extra water for times of hardship.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Hardy Shrub
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This tough conifer pumps its sap with anti-freezing enzymes, allowing it to survive unimaginably low temperatures.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Frozen Planter
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A snow-filled stone trough. This is the perfect home for the small, tough plants that grow on ice-bound worlds.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Ancient Conifer
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This tree lives on an almost geological time scale. Low heat and light levels in their native habitat restrict growth to mere millimeters each season. A sample this size is a botanical marvel.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Marine Rock
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A pleasing mineral formation, crystalised from oceanic salts. May also contain aquatic fossils and/or lifeforms.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Mineral Arch
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A remarkable piece of geological geometry. A stable load-bearing arch, infused with curiously angular solid geodes.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Gem-Encrusted Rock
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
Once a discarded byproduct of deep-level crystal mining, the aesthetic value of the rocks is now better appreciated.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Flarecap Toadstool
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This species of fungus is notable for its dense capillary network and bioluminescent qualities. A circulating chain of chemical reactions produces the toadstool's nocturnal glow.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Wizened Stump
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This ancient stump was harvested from a clonal tree colony, estimated to have lived for over a hundred millennia. Its bark releases a pleasant mossy fragrance.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Mud Hut
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This simple mud hut was modelled after a mysterious structure discovered in the mists of planet Saxm A13. Similar structures have been found throughout the universe, with no proven hypothesis regarding their origin.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Chitinous Cage
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A proteinous formation of unknown origin, replicated aboard the Space Anomaly. Its skeletal structure often retains pockets of air, leading to slightly warmer or cooler temperatures in the centre of the cage.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Protea Wheel
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This unusual lifeform, dominated by a wheel of photophore glands, is difficult to classify neatly into flora or fauna. The thick columns of thorns help protect the flavoursome glands from predators.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Vigilant Taro
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
The eye-like protrusions on this bizarre organism are capable of both processing light and performing simple calculations, although it is unclear what they are watching for...

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Void Husk
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This eggshell still whispers a faint song, as though connected to a distant chorus...

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Plate Stem
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
The broad, plate-like leaf topping this tree is highly efficient for photosynthesis, and wild specimens can grow to extraordinary heights. This domestic variety is cultivated to be suitable to furnish habitations.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Compound Bulb
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This vegetative structure is high in antioxidants, though a thick layer of scales makes it impractical for farming.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Igneous Crystal
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
A quiet roar sounds from within this natural crystal formation, lava and gas dancing in a perpetual cycle of heating and solidifying. Mesmerising to the eye, but despite the ultrahot core, only slightly warm to the touch.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Igneous Drop
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
This hybrid of egg and rock is known to form around the larvae of certain species, keeping the vulnerable creature warm and protected as it develops over the course of several decades. Membranous splits in the rock's surface expose the ever-shifting molten heart.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Archaic Habitation Heater
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
Although primitive in design, this habitation heater is nonetheless a popular home furnishing. Its hypnotic flames and gentle crackling lend a comforting ambience to any room.

Provides interior decoration opportunities for bases.

name: Saucer Fungus
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: This fungal growth, identifiable by its wide, smooth cap and luminescent pores, is native to a variety of cave biomes. Saucer Fungi enjoy a symbiotic relationship with many species of burrowing creatures.

name: Cave Creeper
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A hardy variety of lampenflora. This creeping vine occurs naturally in damp, subterranean environments, but will thrive as a free-standing shrub in any biome type.

name: Troglotulip
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: This attractive glowing flower is remarkable for its scent, reminiscent of freshly tilled soil. Due to the plant's mineral-rich diet, the stamens often contain traces of cobalt.

name: Veined Flat Caps
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: Clusters of these large mushrooms can be found growing in underground caves. The surface 'veins' form part of an unusual gill structure, releasing spores from both above and below the fungus's cap.

name: Fingery Deposit
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: This stalagmite was formed by the dripping of cobalt-rich moisture over several millennia. It is eternally cold to the touch, as though the rock recalls the temperature of its home cave.

name: Antimatter Observation Orb
subtitle: Space Anomaly Replica Part
description: This spiked chamber contains a globule of antimatter, creating an unusual display piece for discerning base builders.

name: Synthesis Core
subtitle: Space Anomaly Replica Part
description:
A replica of the mysterious orb utilised by Polo's Quicksilver Synthesis Companion.

The physical properties of the orb are forever shifting in strangely rhythmic patterns: temperature, radioactivity and density all fluctuating to an unheard song.

name: Bubble Vat
subtitle: Space Anomaly Replica Part
description: A miniaturised replica of the bubbling 'liquid' vat which forms part of the Space Anomaly's anatomy. This mesmerising ornament brings an echo of Polo and Nada's anomalous home to planetary bases.

name: Bubble Duct
subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
description:
This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'.

Intelligently welds into different shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

name: Bubble Duct
subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
description:
This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'.

Weld together with different duct shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

name: L-Shaped Bubble Duct
subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
description:
This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'. This L-shaped configuration allows for curves in duct connections.

Weld together with different duct shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

name: T-Shaped Bubble Duct
subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
description:
This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'. This T-shaped configuration allows for creating branches in duct connections.

Weld together with different duct shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

name: X-Shaped Bubble Duct
subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
description:
This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'. This X-shaped configuration allows for connecting four ducts in a cruciform arrangement.

Weld together with different duct shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

name: Full Sail
subtitle: Decoration
description: This full sail replicates the design of the ancient maritime trade vessels of the Gek, and makes for a striking nautical-themed home decoration.

name: Offset Sails
subtitle: Decoration
description: These offset sails replicate the design of the ancient maritime trade vessels of the Gek, and make for a striking nautical-themed home decoration.

name: Asymmetrical Sails
subtitle: Decoration
description: These asymmetrical sails replicate the design of the ancient maritime trade vessels of the Gek, and make for a striking nautical-themed home decoration.

name: Draped Canvas
subtitle: Decoration
description: This draped canvas half-sail replicates the design of the ancient maritime trade vessels of the Gek, and makes for a striking nautical-themed home decoration.

name: Classic Chair
subtitle: Furniture
description: A sturdy, well-constructed seat, standardised for installation in Space Stations across the galaxies. Its angular design is surprisingly ergonomic.

name: Illuminated Pot
subtitle: Decoration
description: This clay plant pot features a climate neutralising field, nutrient recycling system, and integrated drip tray. Ideal for showcasing decorative plants or other decorations.

name: Tall Spikegrass
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. This variety is characterised by very long, thin blades, covered in very fine hairs.

name: Short Spikegrass
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. This variety, like its taller cousin, is characterised by long hirsute blades - but grows more densely, with slightly heftier blades.

name: Flatblade Grass
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. The wide, flat blades secrete a fragrant, unpleasant-tasting sap to deter predators.

name: Looping Grass
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. This variety features attractively curled blades, which furl and unfurl to allow the plant to maintain a constant internal temperature.

name: Ribbon Grass
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. Closely related to certain varieties of seaweed, ribbon grass can be identified by its long rippling blades and fine hexagonal surface texture.

name: Cloven Paw Grass
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. Cloven paw bears more structural similarity to a shrub than a true grass, and features large glossy leaves for rapid photosynthesis.

name: Antler Grass
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. The branching blades of this variety are formed of woody, twig-like armour insulating thick veins of moisture-storing resin.

name: Nighttongue Flowers
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A hardy floral patch, genetically modified to thrive in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. Barbed petals protect the flowers from would-be predators, piercing flesh with a deadly toxin. Haz-Mat Gauntlets recommended while handling.

name: Urchin Flowers
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A hardy floral patch, genetically modified to thrive in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. These unusually-shaped flowers are packed with pollen, and release a dizzyingly sweet perfume.

name: Eternal Eye Flowers
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description: A hardy floral patch, genetically modified to thrive in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. These ligulate blossoms remain open day and night, absorbing light from both local and distant stars.

name: Covered Silos
subtitle: Decoration
description: A set of tarpaulin-draped silo barrels, containing cargo of questionable provenance.

name: Covered Crate
subtitle: Decoration
description: A large crate, sealed and prepared for transportation. The tarpaulin wrapping conceals the precise nature of this cargo, obscuring whether all the export stamps are where they ought to be...

name: Industrial Crane
subtitle: Decoration
description: Heavy machinery, for lifting and relocating heavy cargo. Despite the crane's size, the rotation-resistant hoist rope and AI-corrected swivel allow for extremely precise movements.

name: "Euclid Moonrise" Sign
subtitle: Decoration
description:
An attention-grabbing welcome sign, illuminated by an array of gas-discharge tubes.

Design salvaged from the "Euclid Moonrise", a Vy'keen joint with an insalubrious reputation.

name: "Ship and Pilot" Sign
subtitle: Decoration
description:
An attention-grabbing welcome sign, illuminated by an array of gas-discharge tubes.

subtitle: Placeable Sludge
description:
Gelatinous and slowly pulsing, this puddle of living slime smells sweeter than would be imagined.

Though there is no evidence to suggest it would be unsafe to do so, avoid treading on the slime where possible.

name: Orange Pustule
subtitle: Organic Decoration
description:
The flesh of this sinister squash is always warm, and slightly luminous. Despite these strange qualities, it is quite edible, and releases a comforting aroma wherever it grows.

Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

name: Rounded Laser
subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
description:
An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This articulated mining laser is insulated with a lightweight gel, ensuring ultimate comfort for companions assisting with resource harvesting.

Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

name: Movement Tracker
subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
description:
An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This compact device generates detailed analytics reports of creature traversal habits, to provide explorers with insight into the secret lives of their animal companions.

Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

name: Energy Coil
subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
description:
An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This dual-purpose laser responds to the biological vitals of its wearer, providing an adaptive level of warmth and light, as well as soft pulses to soothe anxiety.

Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

name: Singing Sea-Snail
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A voice like honey from a mouth of mucus."

name: Golden Jellyfish
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Its tentacles that glitter like wisps of golden hair, but sting with the fire of thousand suns."

name: Dragonfish
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Territorial, ancient, furious to be caught. The king of the sea."

name: The Lunker
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A true titan of the depths. Nothing compares for sheer mass."

name: Emeril Sunstar
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Its perfect crystalline form glistens with a emerald light that changes the soul of all those whose eyes fall upon it."

name: Vampire Squid
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A true error of the deep; its hungry bite corrupts your blood, filling your body with a spurting corrosive bile."

name: Bleached Bonefish
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Robbed of flesh and stripped of colour by acid seas, the bonefish swims on regardless."

name: Translucent Gulper
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Seemingly weak and fragile at the surface, these giant jaws have swallowed alive many an unwary soul who ventured into their abyssal home..."

name: Many-Eyed Jellyfish
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A thousand eyes erupt from its soft flesh: a never-ending cycle of rising, blinking, sinking, and re-emergence."

name: Aberrant Duskfin
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Its wings beat slowly as it sails though the poisoned seas, a drifter with no place of rest, no end to their journey."

name: Gamma Squid
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A pale blue glow surrounds it as it drifts through the water - a warning to all those who would come too close..."

name: Helix Sawfish
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Polymorphic, twisting, always in motion; its body a constant whirr of shifting forms and ripping teeth."

name: Starshell Crab
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Its glittering shell is practically unbreakable, a material of pure perfection."

name: Mirrorscale Skipper
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Impossible to see with mortal eyes as it flashes through the water under boiling, cloudless skies."

name: Jelly of the Veil
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A dark cloud follows this creature, and dreams of doom await all those who touch it."

name: Ancient Irontail
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Heart of stone and fins of iron, this creature lives on where all else falters."

name: Crystal Jelly
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A living snowflake: frozen solid yet still alive, its tentacles a fractal recursion."

name: Ghostfin
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A name only spoken in whispers, its pale body a illusion that flickers beneath the moonlit waves."

name: Iceblood Gulper
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A heart that beats but once a hour, a heart that sees faster life spawn and die, spawn and die, spawn and die..."

name: Nautilia
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "None would believe the scale of this beast: its colossal shell, its enormous slimy foot. None, except those who have seen it..."

name: Glass Angel
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A creature of dreams, only visible where the light refracts through its soft, perfect jelly."

name: Mist Serpent
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "When hunting, can dissolve into a thin dark cloud, impossible to track, impossible to see coming..."

name: Reef Guardian
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A powerful, muscular body and teeth like razors, these gentle giants protect smaller creatures from predators."

name: Blind Titancore
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "The old man of the sea; scarred, blinded, still swimming on..."

name: Fragile Icthyoscale
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A delicate creature, a fragment of the past that lives on in the water."

name: Titanworm Larva
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "The many-mouths arise from the darkness of the ocean; the many-mouths hunger for their home in the sand..."

name: Ossified Deinosuchus
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "A relic of another age, a fusion of life and stone that refuses to die."

name: Megalodon
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "The apex of marine predation, a perfect killing machine. Beware."

name: Sentient Crab
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Deep feeling swims in those watery eyestalks, the thoughtful intelligence of a true ancient."

name: Brain Eel
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "It slides beneath the waves; it slides between the ears; it slides within the folds, and swims forever in your dreams."

name: The Hunter Below
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Streamlined, deadly, perfect: the terror of the deep."

name: Leviathan Spawn
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "So young and fragile, despite its years beneath the waves. And yet thousands more years must pass before it joins the great herd in the stars..."

name: Mandelbrot Worm
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "The geometry of its impossible body folds within itself, a writhing thread of flesh and spacetime."

name: Mother-of-Quicksilver
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Brilliantly ablaze, its surface a perfect liquid sun..."

name: Hyper-cockle
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Both alive and not alive; at once a creature, a mineral, and a moment from another time..."

name: The Maw of Titan
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "So few things survive in waters such as these... so that which thrives should strike fear into the heart of any thinking being."

name: Abyssal Horror Egg
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Listen to these words: Do not allow this egg to hatch. Cast it back into the sea."

name: Atlantidian Crab
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Shell and claw of perfect crystal, eyestalks aglow with purple rage; a being displaced from another reality and cast here as crab."

name: Child of Helios
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "Its song resonates across time and space, calling to its home in the endless black above. One day, it will rise and return to its home among the stars."

name: Many-Mouthed Lunker
subtitle: Legendary Fish
description: "On the surface or below the waves, the vessel hungers, the vessel feeds..."

name: Child of Aquarius

An impossibly delicate jellyfish. Its tentacles are as fine as strands of hair, its entire being glassy, dancing on the edge of what is possible.

A gift from the sea, almost too precious to keep...

name: Creature Pellets
subtitle: Compressed Nutrients
description:
Basic creature bait. Can be placed directly or accessed via the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

This bait will attract creatures and cause them to yield Faecium. Once a creature has been fed, they may be tamed or farmed for their produce.

Dropping bait may calm angry creatures.

name: Synthetic Worms

description:
A specialist bait for carnivores. Use the Analysis Visor to discover the bait preferences of specific creatures.

Feeding using the correct bait will allow creatures to be ridden or harvested. It will also calm predators. Chose bait type from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

description:
Hyper-compressed carbon, this substance's dense nanostructure makes it highly valuable as both an energy source and a technology component.

Synthesised from Condensed Carbon.

name: Rare Metal Element
subtitle: Concentrated Metal Deposit
description:
A highly-prized metal product, this rare element is used in the manufacture of several advanced technologies.

Metal is highly reactive and quickly bonds to exposed skin. User is advised to handle with extreme caution.

Synthesised from Magnetised Ferrite.

name: TetraCobalt
subtitle: Concentrated Cobalt Deposit
description:
A novel molecular form of Cobalt, requiring very high energy levels to create. Natural occurrence is extremely rare.

Synthesised from Ionised Cobalt.

name: Chloride Lattice
subtitle: Concentrated Chlorine Deposit
description:
A tightly-bonded form of Chlorine. Rigidly-packed molecules offer unrivalled conductivity. Not known to form spontaneously: creation requires highly-focused energy inputs.

Synthesised from Chlorine.

name: Destablised Sodium
subtitle: Concentrated Sodium Deposit
description:
Sodium is typically highly stable, but certain configurations retain the reactivity of its component ions. User is advised to wear Hazardous Material Gauntlets before handling.

Synthesised from Sodium.

name: Superoxide Crystal
subtitle: Concentrated Oxygen Deposit
description:
A para-magnetic form of Oxygen, this rare substance has much to offer in the production of advanced technologies. Requires conversion prior to input into Life Support systems. Direct inhalation is NOT recommended.

Synthesised from Oxygen.

name: Oxygen Filter
subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
description:
A specialist technology component.

This small device can rapidly change the gaseous environment within a device, handling conditions from total vacuum to pure oxygen atmospheres.

name: Salt Refractor
subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
description:
A specialist technology component, vital to the complex internals of modern laser systems. 

This light-scattering device takes advantage of the unique optical properties of stabilised and polished salt, to both slow and refract passing photons.

name: Cobalt Mirror
subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
description:
A specialist optical component.

Employing a polished cobalt surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.

name: Sodium Diode
subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
description:

The refined sodium electrode within its vacuum tube gives this diode specialist surge-protection capabilities.

name: Oxygen Capsule
subtitle: Portable Life Support Power
description:

Easily assembled from Oxygen and Ferrite Dust. Offers an efficient method for long-term life support power.

name: Advanced Ion Battery
subtitle: Portable Energy Storage
description:

Constructed from Ionised Cobalt and Pure Ferrite, and occasionally found in cylindrical metal containers.

description:

Attaches directly to corridors.

subtitle: Core Freighter Module
description:
An unsheltered observation deck. Allows the user to step outside the freighter hull, and gaze directly into the vastness of space.

A Bulkhead Door must be installed to allow access to exterior spaces.

name: Exterior Catwalk
subtitle: Core Freighter Module
description:
This exterior walkway intelligently adjoins to existing freighter rooms, creating decking outside the hull of large starships.

A Bulkhead Door must be installed to allow access to exterior spaces.

name: Bulkhead Door
subtitle: Core Freighter Module
description:
A thick, robust door.

Hermetically sealed for installation in the freighter hull, or between internal corridors and rooms.

name: Reinforced Window
subtitle: Core Freighter Module
description:
A pane of low thermal expansion glass.

Can be fitted into the freighter hull to open up a view into space.

name: Internal Freighter Wall
subtitle: Core Freighter Module
description: An interior wall to subdivide large freighter spaces. Seamlessly configures itself to fit the aesthetics of the surrounding room.

name: Scanner Room
subtitle: Planetary Probe
description:
Advanced integrated freighter equipment. Upon use, this planetary scanner probes all celestial bodies in the local solar system. This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

Scanned moons and planets are Discovered, and sensors collect high-level data such as weather conditions and prominent resources.

name: Galactic Trade Room
subtitle: Advanced Freighter Module
description:
Integrated freighter equipment providing instant local access to the galactic trade market for resources and commodities.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

name: Fleet Command Room
subtitle: Expedition Management Terminal
description:
Core Fleet Management Station. This advanced holographic communications station is vital for managing fleet expeditions from the comfort of your capital ship. This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

User is advised that multiple stations are required to manage more than one expedition at a time.

name: Teleport Chamber
subtitle: Long-Distance Matter Transfer Device
description:
Vital integrated freighter equipment. This personal teleport device allows the user to move quickly between their freighter, planetary bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network. User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

name: Appearance Modifier Room
subtitle: Customise Personal Visuals
description:
Integrated freighter equipment allowing the user to adjust their personal appearance settings. This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

The module applies advanced holographic techniques to recalibrate the light around the user, allowing them to adopt whatever appearance they desire. Visual data must be properly formatted before use.

name: Science Specialist's Room
subtitle: Worker Terminal
description:
Integrated freighter research equipment tailored to the needs of scientists, and equipped for research and development of scientific blueprints.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

name: Construction Specialist's Room
subtitle: Worker Terminal
description:
Integrated freighter research equipment tailored to the needs of construction overseers, and equipped with architectural and engineering design software.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

name: Storage Shuttle Room
subtitle: Advanced Freighter Module
description:
Advanced integrated freighter equipment. Construction allows the user to summon the Storage Shuttle while in the same system as their freighter.

Place excess materials in the shuttle Inventory, then launch to transfer contents to the freighter Inventory.

Interfaces with the Exosuit Quick Command Menu for ease of use.

name: Technology Room (Expansion)
subtitle: Advanced Freighter Module
description: A spacious chamber with a technical aesthetic, for expanding habitable spaces inside large spaceships.

name: Cultivation Chamber
subtitle: Agricultural Module
description:
A temperature controlled bio-room. A bed of nutrient-rich soil provides ideal conditions for cultivating agricultural crops.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

name: Double Cultivation Chamber
subtitle: Agricultural Module
description:
A temperature controlled bio-room. Two beds of nutrient-rich soil provide ideal conditions for cultivating agricultural crops.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

name: Nutrition Room
subtitle: Advanced Freighter Module
description:

User is advised that consumption of generated products is entirely at their own risk.

name: Agricultural Specialist's Room
subtitle: Worker Terminal
description:

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

name: Biological Room (Expansion)
subtitle: Advanced Freighter Module
description: This spacious greenhouse chamber naturally filters and oxygenates the air supply, and offers a little sanctuary of green in freighter habitation.

name: Refiner Room
subtitle: Advanced Freighter Module

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

name: Stellar Extractor Room
subtitle: Advanced Freighter Module
description:
Advanced integrated freighter equipment. Gathers resources directly from the interstellar medium, via a complex system of suction intakes and condensing tubes. The gathered substance varies with the local star classification.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

description: Corridor with reinforced glass roofing.

name: Access Ramp

name: Bio-Dome
subtitle: Construction module
description: An attractive domed room which is perfect for cultivating a wide range of botanical matter.

name: Curved Cuboid Roof

name: Curved Cuboid Wall

name: Glass Cuboid Room

name: Cuboid Room Frame

name: Cuboid Inner Door

description: An inner door module used to divide cuboid rooms.

name: Cuboid Inner Wall
subtitle: Construction module
description: An inner wall module used to divide cuboid rooms.

name: Cuboid Roof Cap
subtitle: Construction module
description: A cuboid roof cap used to decorate and reinforce the rooftops of cuboid structures.

name: Interior Stairs
subtitle: Construction module
description: A set of stairs to improve access inside cuboid structures.

name: Door
subtitle: Construction item
description: A compression-sealed, standard door suitable for all rooms and corridors.

name: Holo-Door
subtitle: Construction module
description: An elegant holographic door which allows quick access to any structure while regulating the temperature and toxicity of the interior.

name: Viewing Sphere
subtitle: Construction module
description: A self-contained spherical viewing platform which affords the user stunning views of the surrounding environment.

name: Cylindrical Room Frame
subtitle: Construction module
description: A lightweight, industrial alternative to the standard Cylindrical Room.

name: Curved Corridor
subtitle: Construction module
description: A sturdy, large corridor module for connecting rooms, with a curved bend.

name: Square Room
subtitle: Construction module
description: A square alternative to the core module for base construction, providing a generous central space on which to expand.

name: Square Room
subtitle: Construction module
description: A square alternative to the core module for base construction, providing a generous central space on which to expand.

name: Base Computer
subtitle: Site Evaluation Device
description:
Portable land registration service.

When placed, contacts Universal Cartographic Archive to establish ownership of land. Successful registration allows the construction of base modules across any site of the user's choosing.

name: Landing Pad
subtitle: Construction module
description: A stable, reinforced landing pad for starships.

name: Galactic Trade Terminal
subtitle: Trading terminal
description: A trading terminal that provides instant local access to the market for resources and commodities.

name: Health Station
subtitle: Health recharge module
description: A wall mounted module that can be used to recharge health.

name: Hazard Protection Unit
subtitle: Hazard Protection Charging System
description:
A wall mounted module that can be used to recharge the user's Hazard Protection systems.

The Hazard Protection Unit must be kept charged with a source of fuel.

name: Save Point
subtitle: Construction module
description: A buildable save point for managing your progress.

name: Save Beacon
subtitle: Portable waypoint marker
description:
Once activated, beacons provide a permanent navigational waypoint, facilitating repeat visits to specific locations.

Allows user to record their progress at any time.

name: Signal Booster
subtitle: Environmental scanner
description:
A versatile scanner that detects nearby buildings. Can decrypt Navigation Data to pinpoint specific locations.

The Signal Booster can be dismantled and redeployed for easy transportation.

name: Antimatter Reactor
subtitle: Baryogenesis Unit
description:
An autonomous baryogenesis reactor, this device can be left to harvest reality paradoxes and convert them into usable antimatter. User must monitor fuel levels to ensure continued operation.

The resulting antimatter is safely contained, ready for use in all standard hyperspace power units.

name: Base Teleport Module
subtitle: Long-Distance Matter Transfer Device
description:
A personal teleport device, allowing the user to move quickly between their constructed bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network.

User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.

name: Base Teleport Module
subtitle: Long-Distance Matter Transfer Device
description:
A personal teleport device, allowing the user to move quickly between their constructed bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network.

User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.

name: Base Salvage Capsule
subtitle: Autonomous Storage Device
description:
A construction recovery device.

This optional piece of base technology stores and preserves matter left over after the destruction of a previous base.

name: Construction Research Unit
subtitle: Technology Recovery Device
description:
Portable blueprint research device.

This field-deployable research module allows the user to convert old or damaged technology modules into advanced construction blueprints.

name: Portable Refiner
subtitle: Automated Refinery Unit
description:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Portable Refiner can be dismantled and redeployed for easy transportation. Note: the Portable Refiner requires fuel to operate.

name: Medium Refiner
subtitle: Automated Refinery Unit
description:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Medium Refiner allows two different substances to be combined into one new material, or materials to be processed at better ratios. 

The Medium Refiner must be installed in a Habitable Base, but does not require additional power sources.

name: Large Refiner
subtitle: Automated Refinery Unit
description:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.

The Large Refiner allows three different substances to be combined into one new material, or materials to be processed at better ratios. 

The Large Refiner must be installed in a Habitable Base, but does not require additional power sources.

name: Appearance Modifier
subtitle: Customise Personal Visuals
description:
A buildable module that allows the users to adjust their personal appearance settings.

The module applies advanced holographic techniques to recalibrate the light around the user, allowing them to adopt whatever appearance they desire. Visual data must be properly formated before use.

name: Nutrient Processor
subtitle: Portable Sustenance Unit
description:
A portable nutrient extractor, able to process and refine gathered ingredients into edible food products.

User is advised that consumption of generated products is entirely at their own risk.

name: Automated Feeder
subtitle: Agricultural Robot
description:
A robotic farming unit, designed to automatically supply nearby creatures with food.

When powered, will attract nearby animal life. Keep bait tanks full in order to supply lifeforms with desired food.

name: Livestock Unit
subtitle: Automatic Harvesting Robot
description:
A robotic farming unit, designed to automatically harvest substances from creatures. Requires power.

Creatures that are ready to be harvested for milk, eggs or other specialist produce will approach the Livestock Unit and deposit their yields. The creatures are unharmed by the process.

Will harvest produce from creatures fed by hand or via an Automated Feeder.

name: Muster Point
subtitle: Ship-summoning beacon
description: A buildable device that can summon your starship to it from any location.

name: Message Module
subtitle: Communications terminal
description: A small and accessible information container for leaving messages or viewing left messages and short strings of information.

name: Communications Station
subtitle: Communications terminal
description: A terminal for the composition and transmission of messages to other travellers.

name: Nomad Geobay
subtitle: Construction module
description: An underground secure parking facility for the Nomad light Exocraft.

name: Roamer Geobay
subtitle: Construction module
description: An underground secure parking facility for the Roamer medium Exocraft.

name: Colossus Geobay
subtitle: Construction module
description: An underground secure parking facility for the Colossus large Exocraft.

name: Pilgrim Geobay
subtitle: Construction module
description: An underground secure parking facility for the Pilgrim light Exocraft.

name: Nautilon Chamber
subtitle: Submarine Docking Bay
description: An advanced, fully-airlocked docking station for the Nautilon submarine.

name: Nautilon Platform
subtitle: Surface-Deployable Submarine Bay
description:
An advanced, fully-watertight docking station for the Nautilon submarine.

This specially adapted platform is designed to be deployed on the surface of the water.

name: Exocraft Summoning Station
subtitle: Vehicle Translocation Device
description:
Construction allows the user to summon any owned Exocraft from anywhere else in that system.

Interfaces with the Exosuit Quick Command Menu for ease of use. Can be compressed and carried within the Exosuit with DECONSTRUCT for later redeployment.

name: Minotaur Geobay
subtitle: Heavy Loader Storage Bay
description:
A secure parking, summoning and customisation facility for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.

Deploy the Minotaur from the Quick Menu. With the aid of an Orbital Exocraft Materialiser mounted inside a freighter, the Minotaur can be instantly deployed to any location within the same system as the mothership.

name: Science Terminal
subtitle: Specialist terminal
description: A research station tailored to the needs of Scientists, and equipped for research and development of scientific blueprints.

name: Weapons Terminal
subtitle: Specialist terminal
description: A research station tailored to the needs of Armourers, and equipped for the development of munitions and explosives as well as selected civilian tech.

name: Agricultural Terminal
subtitle: Specialist terminal
description: A research station tailored to the needs of Farmers, and equipped for the analysis and cultivation of farmable crops.

name: Exocraft Terminal
subtitle: Specialist terminal
description: A research station tailored to the needs of Technicians, and equipped with bespoke vehicular design software.

name: Construction Terminal
subtitle: Specialist terminal
description: A research station tailored to the needs of Construction Overseers, and equipped with architectural and engineering design software.

name: Hydroponic Tray
subtitle: Farming tech
description:
A self contained growth system for the indoor cultivation of agricultural crops.

Build requirement: Must be placed indoors.

name: Large Hydroponic Tray
subtitle: Farming tech
description:
A self contained growth system for the indoor cultivation of agricultural crops. Can support up to four plants.

Build requirement: Must be placed indoors.

name: Fungal Cluster
subtitle: Plantable Seed
description:
A spherical fungus with internal gills, found only in toxic biomes. Fungal Clusters can be transplanted for cultivation, yielding a bountiful harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Toxic climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 4 hours

name: Frostwort
subtitle: Plantable Seed
description:
A large crystal flower with radiant blue blooms, found only in snowy biomes. Frostwort can be farmed and makes a reliable crop, and its adaptation to harsh conditions results in highly frequent harvests.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Frozen climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 1 hour

name: Gamma Weed
subtitle: Plantable Seed
description:
A luminous, leafy flowering plant that thrives in radioactive biomes and can be cultivated to yield a bountiful harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Radioactive climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 4 hours

name: Echinocactus
subtitle: Plantable Seed
description:
Native to barren biomes and capable of withstanding long periods of drought, Echinocactus is an edible succulent that responds well to cultivation, yielding a large but occasional harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Barren climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 16 hours

name: Star Bramble
subtitle: Plantable Seed
description:
A medium-sized, farmable plant that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Star Bulbs.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Lush climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 4 hours

name: Solar Vine
subtitle: Plantable Seed
description:
This 'living rock' is adapted to live in the extreme heat of scorched biomes. However, it can be farmed in most environments and, once established, yields a moderate harvest.

Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Hot climate before planting outdoors.

Approximate growing time: 16 hours

name: Mordite Root
subtitle: Plantable Seed
description:
An inedible tuber that produces a small yield of Mordite crystals.

A peaceful alternative to the process of harvesting Mordite from the corpses of creatures. Mordite Root must be grown in a Hydroponics Tray.

Approximate growing time: 8 hours

name: Gutrot Flower
subtitle: Plantable Seed
description:
A foul-smelling, farmable flower that replicates the chemical structure of faecal matter. When planted inside, yields a harvest of Faecium.

A good alternative to collecting Faecium by hand, which requires feeding creatures and then harvesting their droppings. Gutrot Flowers must be grown in a Hydroponics Tray.

Approximate growing time: 4 hours

name: Gravitino Host
subtitle: Plantable Seed

name: Oxygen Harvester
subtitle: Atmosphere Processing Device
description:
An autonomous atmosphere extractor, this device can be left to collect and purify oxygen from the air. User must monitor fuel levels to ensure continued operation.

The resulting gas is compressed and processed, ready for use in all standard life support systems.

name: Automated Trap

An autonomous fishing device, designed for long-term deployment in a wide-range of water conditions.

Once activated, the system will lure and trap any nearby aquatic creatures and store them for later retrieval.

name: Mineral Extractor
subtitle: Substance Distribution Module
description:
An automated mineral harvester. Determine a site with the Surveying upgrade for the Analysis Visor. Mineral extraction rates and produced minerals will vary from site to site.

Requires power to function. Connect to Silos with Pipelines to allow collection from more convenient sites.

name: Gas Extractor
subtitle: Substance Distribution Module
description:
An automated gas harvester. Determine a site with the Surveying upgrade for the Analysis Visor. Gas extraction rates and produced gases will vary from site to site.

Requires power to function. Connect to Silos with Pipelines to allow collection from more convenient sites.

name: Supply Depot
subtitle: Substance Distribution Module
description:
Automated storage unit. Connect to a Supply Grid using Pipelines.

Automatically stores the output of various Mineral and Gas Extractors, allowing for increased capacity and more efficient siting. Can be located a long distances from the extraction site.

name: Solar Panel
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
An efficient power generator, this solar array will turn sunlight into the electrical energy required to power many base structures.

Generates no power at night. Partner with Batteries to store energy for the hours of darkness.

name: Electromagnetic Generator
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
When suitably placed in an area of high field strength, efficient electromagnetic dynamos are used to generate near limitless power.

Locate appropriate sites with the Surveying upgrade for the Analysis Visor. Power output will vary from site to site.

name: Biofuel Reactor
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
A small power generator. Burns carbon-based fuel placed in its furnace tank and converts it into usable power.

Connect power generators to base structures and technologies with electrical wiring. Many parts require power to function.

name: Electrical Wiring
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
High-capacity electrical wiring. Use wiring to connect Power Generators to your base. Most technology, as well as structures with embedded lighting systems, require a power source to operate.

Wiring can be connected to various switches to facilitate selective power flow.

name: Teleport Cable
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description: Advanced fibre-optic cabling, designed to link one or more Short-Range Teleporters.

name: ByteBeat Cable
subtitle: ByteBeat Extension
description:
Advanced cabling, designed to link one or more Bytebeat Generators or to connect a Bytebeat Switch to the network.

The signal will synchronize connected lights and device to the generated waveform.

name: Wall Switch
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when pulled.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

name: Floor Switch
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when stood upon or otherwise activated.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

name: Battery
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
Highly-efficient energy storage units. Connect to a power grid, and onboard power management circuits will automatically draw down spare capacity to charge its cells.

When the grid attempts to draw more power than is currently supplied, the battery will automatically deploy power to make up the shortfall.

name: Button
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when used.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

name: Proximity Switch
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when an entity is detected nearby.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

name: Supply Pipe
subtitle: Substance Distribution Module
description:
Flexible, high-strength piping. Able to withstand a highly-pressurised internal environment.

Used for connecting various Mineral and Gas Extractors to Silos

name: Power Inverter
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when used.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

name: Auto Switch
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
A power management device, this switch will toggle the flow of power when signaled by an incoming signal.

Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

name: Short-Range Teleporter
subtitle: Instantaneous Transport Network
description:
A low-powered teleporter, construction for instantaneous travel across short distances.

When wired to both a power source and another short-range teleporter, allows near-instant travel between nearby locations.

name: Short-Range Teleporter
subtitle: Instantaneous Transport Network
description:
A low-powered teleporter, construction for instantaneous travel across short distances.

When wired to both a power source and another short-range teleporter, allows near-instant travel between nearby locations.

name: Bytebeat Switch
subtitle: ByteBeat Extension
description: A musical switching device, designed to interpret waveform signals generated by a Bytebeat Generator and output electrical impulses to connected lights and other devices.

name: Electrical Cloaking Unit
subtitle: Power Distribution Module
description:
Device to enable a wireless aesthetic in habitable bases.

Constructing the Electrical Cloaking Unit within a powered base will reduce the visual prominence of all local Electrical Wiring. Hidden wires will continue to supply electricity, provided they are sufficiently powered.

subtitle: Collected Flotsam
